verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS research platform, but the evidence pack never mentions on-premise deployment, downloadable builds, or any self-hosted option. Every cited capability, including the API at elicit.com/api/v2 and the MCP server at elicit.com/api/mcp, is vendor-hosted. API and MCP access are hosted integration points, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
